dataset: artifacts/134-mixture-next-gains/dataset.pkl — reconstruction of the 130 frozen walk-forward cache (6 members × 2020–2026 × {preweight, full}), parity with 130 winner NLL ≤ 8.9e-16
baseline: served recipe reconstructed: six annually corrected members (130 annual coefficients), equal weights, arithmetic mean of win, no post-average step

used_periods.confirmation_this_round: 2025-01-01..2026-08-23 (cache end). Already consumed by earlier research (110–130) for the bundle itself; for THIS round it is unseen by the candidate choice and is therefore a 'confirmation for this round', not a globally untouched holdout.
used_periods.untouched: 2026-09-13 onward = the 133 production-vs-old prospective window; not used here

primary_definition: p_served ∝ p̄^γ with p̄ = served mixture win; γ fit by minimising winner NLL (golden section on [0.5, 2.0]) on ALL eligible races of the two most recent calendar years strictly before the scored year, on the same input regime as the scored prediction; renormalised within the race; top2/top3 then follow the production convention (Harville + stage discount).
why_this_variant: On the selection years the three windows were −0.00089 (all prior), −0.00110 (last year), −0.00109 (last two years). Tie between the two recent windows; the two-year window was preferred before looking at 2025–2026 because it uses ~6,900 races instead of ~3,450 for γ and had the narrower CI.

not_advanced.stack: no gain over temperature alone; heads guard marginal

scoring.primary_metric: race-weighted paired winner NLL difference (candidate − baseline), preweight regime
scoring.heads_guard: top2/top3 per-race paired logloss difference under the production convention (λ2/λ3 re-fit per arm on all prior years from 2020, applied to the scored year): 95% CI upper bound ≤ +0.0005 for both heads; pooled equal-mass ECE (10 bins) delta ≤ +0.001 for win/top2/top3

classification.改善が支持される: confirmation 95% CI high < 0 AND heads guard passes
classification.改善方向だが不確実: point < 0 but CI crosses 0 (or heads guard marginal)
classification.悪化・不採用: point > 0 with CI low > 0, or a heads guard CI fails
classification.データ不足: fewer than 2 race days / CI undefined

scoring.uncertainty_scope: CI covers future-race sampling given the annual refits of the cache; it does not cover member retraining variance (the cache is one fresh fit per member-year) nor coefficient re-estimation

next_candidate_if_supported: same bundle + a registered post-mixture temperature step with γ fit on the two most recent complete years (for 2026 use: 2024–2025); production switch is NOT part of this research and would require the 133-type prospective comparison
